subject.title: fix: show readable session names across Windows UX

question: Should Windows adopt the coordinated Gateway presentation contract and hide presentation-classified background sessions by default across the Sessions page, chat picker, tray menu, and dashboard?
rationale: The parser implementation is mechanically compatible, but the upstream contract is unmerged and default hiding intentionally changes which existing sessions users can see; automated review cannot choose that cross-repository UX policy.

options.title: Coordinate contract and visibility
options.body: Approve the presentation schema and background-session policy, land the Gateway contract in a coordinated order, and require native current-head visual proof before merging Windows.

options.title: Land readable titles only
options.body: Keep structured and legacy title resolution but defer default background filtering until each Windows surface has an explicitly approved visibility design.

options.title: Accept fallback-first rollout
options.body: Merge Windows before the Gateway contract using its bounded fallback while explicitly accepting temporary schema drift and the new default visibility behavior.

recommendation.title: Coordinate contract and visibility
recommendation.body: Approve the presentation schema and background-session policy, land the Gateway contract in a coordinated order, and require native current-head visual proof before merging Windows.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns both the Windows implementation and the coordinated Gateway contract proposal, making them the clearest available routing owner for the cross-repository decision.
